g.title: nubot beats every baseline almost all twenty-five drug perturbations distributional
g.desc: NubOT beats every baseline in almost all of the twenty-five drug perturbations on the distributional fit metric.
g.text: NubOT beats every baseline in nearly all 25

g.title: evaluation spans two co-cultured melanoma cell lines distinguished mela sox9
g.desc: The evaluation spans two co-cultured melanoma cell lines distinguished by the MelA and Sox9 markers, imaged at three time points with the 4i technology, and compares against four baselines including the prior state-of-the-art unbalanced GAN.
g.text: imaged with 4i; vs 4 baselines incl. ubOT GAN.

g.title: its predicted per-subpopulation weights correlate observed cell counts coefficient point
g.desc: Its predicted per-subpopulation weights correlate with observed cell counts at a coefficient of point nine five after eight hours, an extremely strong agreement, and still at point four four after twenty-four hours despite drug-induced cell death thinning the observable populations.
g.text: NubOT (red) attains the lowest error at both
NubOT · Neural Unbalanced Optimal Transport · NeurIPS 2022
